overview.text: She has criticized the city’s budget, saying officials are borrowing towards reserves and putting municipal parking structures up as collateral. She also called the city’s $16 million homelessness spending excessive for a small city. She proposes a lobbyist registry to publicly disclose who seeks to influence city decisions. Her campaign says she successfully advocated for a new four-way stop and crosswalk at Motor and Braddock in 2026.
